items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I used to send a message by Mercer. I used to tell Mercer to tell him I'm saying a prayer for him every day.

ctx.x: Yeah. That last trip we was on. See, he was working night by night. And I know he was sick. He was just barely making it. He told Mercer don't take the bus too far away from him, because he may have to leave any minute, to come home. That's when he left to come home.
